ns2:section.sectionText: FA22 - CW 463, Screenwriting: This course is an introduction to writing for the screen. Students will explore the fundamental theory and skills of story structure, character development, conflict, and scene writing. Students will then apply these principles to develop their own material, from initial premise and character, to a basic outline and a draft of a first act of a feature screenplay. The course will emphasize active participation and discussion with an emphasis on workshopping student writing.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Creative Writing or Creative Writing major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
